claim_positioning: abandon-forward reliability/safety audit; not method superiority
coverage_alignment_policy: width comparisons are permitted only for coverage-aligned cells; non-aligned cells are coverage recovery/collapse diagnostics

decision_utility_policy.multiplicity_action: report family size for threshold/task sweeps and avoid definitive safety claims from isolated cells

feature_schema_policy.purpose: separate feature-missingness shift from residual protocol/dataset shift
